answer: Sybil keys are blocked by a shard-and-walk gate. A newcomer locks 0.85 POA as an opal shard for 14 epochs and reclaims it only after seven signed pings from relays on distinct /20 prefixes. Each ping carries a 28-byte hollow ticket mixed with the noon beacon; tickets closer than 110 min are dropped. A sponsor may back at most one key that shares a knoll of three overlapping route traces. If two vouched keys reuse a four-long ticket sequence, each shard is cut by 0.31 POA and both keys stay muted for 5 epochs. A missed ping never auto-redeems; the shard stays locked until a fresh walk finishes.
